_comment: Diagnostic kind to stable short code. This table is the authority, and the only copy.
It used to exist only in the Rust implementation's src/diag.rs, and it is a cross-language contract,
because logs and issue tracking need it to line up the same event across implementations.
Every implementation should have a test that checks its own enum or constant table against this one.
A short code never changes meaning once published, and a new diagnostic gets a new code rather than reusing an old one.
The full list of kinds, with severity and trigger conditions, is in docs/*/contract.md.
